review_scope: Approval binding, source accounting and once-only execution

findings.old_grant: Rejected at the target entry before any scientific input is opened; the launcher can create a service claim if given a wrong approval file.
findings.accounting: Logical archive reservations rather than measured device I/O. The bound manifest fixes bytes and opens, and ReadGuard checks the current archive size and open allowance before each scientific open.
findings.dispatch: The bound service launch claim and exclusive output directory prevent reuse of the frozen launch and output namespaces. Use only the bound service directory for this proposal.

disposition: Retain the reviewed code and proposal. Submit the exact scope for separate researcher approval before dispatch.
